page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Running head at top with page number at top left. Continuous text in the column, a decorative ornament rule, then a heading "PARALLELUM." and further text. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: dum, nunquid ullo modo nos Evangelio comparabis? aut scripta nostra scripturis canonicis coæquabis? profectò si rectè in judicando sapis, longè nos infra vides abilla authoritate distare, & ne quidem longius, sed utriq; nostrum quantumlibet credas, utrumq; illi excellentiæ nequaquam compa-ras.

Neutiquam ergo sanctos Patres ex supercilio Nestoriano vilipendimus, aut negligimus, sed diligenter evolvimus, rara ipsorum dona admiramur, quæ scripserunt tanquã humana scripta ex Dei verbo examinamus, & errata eorum communi humanæ imbecillitati ascribimus. Hæc omnia cum reverentia sinè contemptu.
main_text.head: PARALLELUM.
main_text.p: Quia autem Harschero placuit circa istam materiam parallelum subiicere & benè multa testimonia ex Calvini institutioni-tutioni.

page.notes: Printed text ends with a hyphenated line "institutioni-" followed by "tutioni." on the last line; the final word is set indented. The ornament rule between paragraphs is not text. Long s rendered as plain s. Some ink is faint in places; readings are best effort.
